goal: Turn Demo Storefront into a guided product-to-qualified-lead journey
context: P2 begins after the dedicated marketing pages pass. The demo should show a realistic Vietnamese fashion store and prove the AI Inbox use case interactively.
requirements: Guide visitors through shopper question, grounded stock/size answer, qualification, lead handoff, and order confirmation
Use realistic consistent product imagery/data, prices, inventory, and transcript details
Make channel labels and AI/human roles clear without excessive badges, emoji, or instructional clutter
Keep journey responsive, keyboard usable, and linked to the relevant product/admin page
acceptance_criteria: A first-time visitor can complete or understand the end-to-end journey without external explanation
Each step changes or explains the product/conversation state rather than serving as a static decorative stepper
Desktop/mobile layouts, interactions, routes, and accessibility are reviewed and recorded
